title: LLM Gateway — LiteLLM
description: Metered truth from the gateway's own spend tables (read-only Postgres). Every consumer = one virtual key; per-key spend/tokens/requests. Complements the fleets' self-reported workforce dashboards — weekly ritual: these numbers vs self-report, drift >10% = accounting bug.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(spend),0) AS value FROM "LiteLLM_DailyUserSpend" WHERE date >= to_char(date_trunc('month', now()), 'YYYY-MM-DD');
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(prompt_tokens+completion_tokens),0) AS value FROM "LiteLLM_DailyUserSpend" WHERE date >= to_char(date_trunc('month', now()), 'YYYY-MM-DD');
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(successful_requests),0) AS ok, COALESCE(SUM(failed_requests),0) AS failed FROM "LiteLLM_DailyUserSpend" WHERE date >= to_char(now() - interval '7 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD');
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cache_read_input_tokens),0) AS value FROM "LiteLLM_DailyUserSpend" WHERE date >= to_char(now() - interval '30 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD');

panels.title: Budget burn per key (lifetime spend vs max budget)

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(key_alias, LEFT(token,8)) AS metric, CASE WHEN max_budget IS NULL OR max_budget = 0 THEN 0 ELSE spend/max_budget END AS value FROM "LiteLLM_VerificationToken" ORDER BY value DESC;

SELECT to_timestamp(d.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS time, COALESCE(v.key_alias, LEFT(d.api_key,8)) AS metric, SUM(d.spend) AS value FROM "LiteLLM_DailyUserSpend" d LEFT JOIN "LiteLLM_VerificationToken" v ON v.token = d.api_key WHERE $__timeFilter(to_timestamp(d.date,'YYYY-MM-DD')) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT to_timestamp(d.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS time, COALESCE(v.key_alias, LEFT(d.api_key,8)) AS metric, SUM(d.prompt_tokens + d.completion_tokens) AS value FROM "LiteLLM_DailyUserSpend" d LEFT JOIN "LiteLLM_VerificationToken" v ON v.token = d.api_key WHERE $__timeFilter(to_timestamp(d.date,'YYYY-MM-DD')) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Per key — spend, tokens, requests (dashboard window)

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(v.key_alias, LEFT(d.api_key,8)) AS key, SUM(d.spend) AS spend_usd, SUM(d.prompt_tokens) AS prompt_tok, SUM(d.completion_tokens) AS completion_tok, SUM(d.cache_read_input_tokens) AS cache_read_tok, SUM(d.api_requests) AS requests, SUM(d.failed_requests) AS failed FROM "LiteLLM_DailyUserSpend" d LEFT JOIN "LiteLLM_VerificationToken" v ON v.token = d.api_key WHERE $__timeFilter(to_timestamp(d.date,'YYYY-MM-DD')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

SELECT COALESCE(model,'?') AS model, SUM(spend) AS spend_usd, SUM(prompt_tokens) AS prompt_tok, SUM(completion_tokens) AS completion_tok, SUM(api_requests) AS requests FROM "LiteLLM_DailyUserSpend" WHERE $__timeFilter(to_timestamp(date,'YYYY-MM-DD')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;
